sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 8 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Some of the right people have started taking an interest in you. Asking about forecasts, wondering how far you'll go. But words are just words! Time to head out there and prove how good you really are."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win 2 rounds in TeamFight, BlastGang or ShootOut mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,700 EXP
- 52,000 Roubles
- 10 GP coins
- Unlocks SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk in the Armory
